dateline: Seoul, South Korea — BTS returns from Las Vegas post-ARIRANG World Tour residency; 'SWIM' claims 7th No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. US; Asia & Australia ARMY presale opens June 2
heroHeadline: Day 4,733: 'SWIM' Claims 7th No. 1 on Billboard Global Excl. US; BTS in Transit to Korea — ARMY Presale for Asia & Australia Opens June 2
heroSubtitle: May 29, 2026 is Day 4,733 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. As BTS travels from Las Vegas back to South Korea following the conclusion of their historic 4-night Allegiant Stadium residency (~260,000 fans, May 23–28), the Billboard chart dated May 30 confirms 'SWIM' has reached No. 1 on the Billboard Global (Excl. US) chart for a seventh time in 2026 — three consecutive weeks — extending BTS's own record for most No. 1 weeks on that survey in a single calendar year. 'SWIM' simultaneously holds No. 55 on the US Hot 100 in its 10th consecutive charting week (an all-time K-pop record on that survey) and No. 10 on the Global 200. All 13 ARIRANG vocal tracks remain on global charts for a ninth consecutive week. The ARMY membership presale for the Asia and Australia legs of the ARIRANG World Tour opens June 2, with general on-sale beginning June 4–5 at btsworldtourofficial.com; shows run November 2026–March 2027 across Kaohsiung, Bangkok, Singapore, Jakarta, Melbourne, Sydney, and Bulacan. BTS's next performance is in Busan at Busan Asiad Main Stadium on June 12–13 — their 13th debut anniversary. BTS × Oreo hotteok-flavored cookies go on sale June 1 in 80+ countries.
